title: A 20 Million Call Bet on a Stock Down Two-Thirds
speaker: tastylive host (Signal vs. Noise)

macro_themes.view: The market is questioning whether the AI build-out can outrun the financing it requires; credit and equity markets disagree sharply on CoreWeave.

notes: Host reports unusual options flow in CRWV (23,910 Apr-2027 90 calls, ~$19.6M premium, bought with stock at 69 Wed close; stock ~64 'this morning') and lays out bull (Wall St avg target $140.58, Nvidia support, Nov 11 earnings) and bear (15% bond yields, 63% implied default) cases, but takes no side and ends with a question. No call recorded. Date set to Thu 2026-10-15 from 'Wednesday close ... this morning'.
